Voice orders skip Apicbase's sign-off: An order spoken into our app travels from the kitchen to the distributor without passing through Apicbase. Nobody approves it there, and Apicbase has no record of it when the delivery and the invoice arrive.
Let the Apicbase count set the amounts: Do the count in Apicbase as you do now and look at what it suggests for that distributor. Then say those amounts into our app, review them and send.

One place per distributor's order: Where every order to that distributor must be signed off, leave it in Apicbase. Where the everyday reorder needs no sign-off, move that one to our app. Order from each distributor through one channel, so no line goes out twice.

@graph.name: Do I need an Apicbase alternative to order with my voice?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Apicbase already builds orders and sends them to your suppliers. If one of your distributors gives you our app, you can say that distributor's order aloud instead.

@graph.name: Is VoiceOrder Solutions better than Apicbase?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not at recipe costing, menu engineering, stock counts, forecasting or invoice matching: we do none of those. Our job is narrower: your spoken order to your distributor, checked by you before it is sent. If ordering is what prompted your search for an Apicbase alternative, that one job, added beside it, may be enough.

@graph.name: Do Apicbase and VoiceOrder Solutions connect?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. They are separate products with separate support teams, and no order data passes from one to the other. That is a real trade-off: Apicbase cannot match that delivery or its invoice to an order it never saw.

@graph.name: Can every supplier take orders this way?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Only distributors that work with VoiceOrder Solutions can receive them, and that is far fewer suppliers than Apicbase reaches by email and by direct link. Keep Apicbase for the rest, and ask your distributors which of them use our app.

@graph.name: Apicbase already takes counts by voice. What does your app add?

acceptedAnswer.text: Its voice feature is for counting stock: you say what is on the shelf. Ours is for sending the order: you say what you want to buy from your account's own guide, and it lands with your distributor as an order.

@graph.name: I said an item wrong. Can I fix it before it goes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Each line is on screen for you to check before it goes, so change the item or the amount there, or delete the line. Checking is the safeguard, and a quick look can still let a mistake through. Orders you phone in or leave on voicemail are not numbered by us.

@graph.name: How do I get set up, and what does it cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Through your distributor. If they have not mentioned us, or you are unsure, get in touch and we will find out for you. Most kitchens are placing orders the same day. Your distributor supplies the app, so ask them about cost; we post no price list. Apicbase quotes its plans as well, with no prices on its site.
